subject: Renewal: On‑prem pilot (isolated cluster) + term addendum
messages:
From: Lucas Hsu <lucas.hsu@stellushealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellushealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Diego,

Thanks for the call this morning. As we discussed, Stellus is approaching the end of our current term and we want to add a small isolated on‑prem pilot (3 nodes, standalone cluster) to validate latency and PHI handling before committing to a broader private footprint. A couple of asks to move forward: 

- Can Redwood provide a provisional Statement of Work that includes an addendum for an isolation SLA (data residency + access controls)?
- We need an estimated one‑time onboarding cost and the monthly committed nodes price for the pilot (12‑month term preferred).
- Stellus procurement needs a network diagram and minimal firewall rules for our infra team.

Attaching our vendor intake form and a rough sketch of the proposed rack placement. Ideally we’d sign something before Nov 30 to lock in FY terms — can you confirm timeline?

Thanks,
Lucas
VP Product, Stellus Health
Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (stub), rack_sketch.jpg (stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Hsu <lucas.hsu@stellushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Lucas — thanks for the clear list. Quick take:

- We can produce a provisional SOW with an Isolation Addendum and 12‑month pilot pricing. I’ll send a draft by EOD tomorrow.
- Estimated onboarding: $18k (one‑time engineering & runbook); monthly committed cost for 3 dedicated nodes: $9,500/mo. I’ll confirm after SE review.
- I’m attaching our network requirements template and a sample minimal firewall ACL.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll route the SOW draft to Kimberly (legal/pricing) and Monica (solutions) for sign‑offs.
2) Set a 30‑minute call with your infra ops to walk the network items (how’s Fri 11/20 10:00am PT?).
3) If you’re good with numbers we’ll include the isolation SLA language and a DocuSign link for a provisional amendment.

Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: network_requirements.xlsx (stub), pilot_network_sketch.png (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Diego/Monica — quick legal/pricing notes: 

- SOW: we’ll draft the Isolation Addendum as a short annex referencing data residency, role‑based access, and KMS integration. Keep the pilot term 12 months and include an option to convert to a longer Private contract at a pre‑agreed uplift price.
- Pricing: $18k onboarding + $9.5k/mo seems reasonable for an initial offer. If Stellus converts within 90 days, apply a 10% credit of onboarding back on the first invoice.
- SLA: include a 99.5% monthly availability target for the pilot cluster with an exception window for scheduled maintenance (minimum 48h advance notice).

I’ll review the draft SOW once Diego uploads. Monica — can you confirm the engineering estimate and any constraints for a 3‑node on‑prem config?

Kimberly
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Adding SE confirmation and a small ops note: 

- 3 nodes (NVIDIA T4 equivalent / quantized runtime) is feasible as a pilot. Expected peak tokens/sec for your test harness ~ 120TPS (we estimated in call).
- Runbook and HA: we’ll provide a curtailed HA config (active/passive) and a fallback plan to redirect traffic to our hosted fallback pool if you hit total node loss. We should include a short paragraph in the SOW describing automatic fallback behavior and cost implications when fallback is used.
- Network: minimal outbound to our collection endpoints + specific port list (see Diego’s attached worksheet).

I will markup the SOW with the ops acceptance criteria and hand it back to Diego by EOD. Fri 11/20 10:00am PT works for a 30‑minute infra sync — please invite your network lead.

Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_provisional_isolation_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Hsu <lucas.hsu@stellushealth.com>, procurement@stellushealth.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Lucas — attaching the provisional SOW and the network worksheet Kimberly/Monica referenced. Highlights: 

- One‑time onboarding: $18,000 (includes on‑site checklist, runbook creation).
- Pilot commitment: 12 months at $9,500/mo for 3 dedicated nodes.
- Conversion option: convert to Private deployment within 90 days with onboarding credit (10%) applied to first invoice.
- Isolation Addendum: data residency, RBAC, KMS note, and a fallback policy to hosted pool if nodes become unavailable.

Requesting your confirmation on the pricing and the Fri 11/20 10:00am PT infra call. If all good I’ll push the SOW to DocuSign and route the procurement link.

Cheers,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_provisional_isolation_v1.pdf (stub), network_requirements.xlsx (stub)

From: Lucas Hsu <lucas.hsu@stellushealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: isolated on‑prem cluster + renewal questions

Diego — good; procurement and infra reviewed the numbers and the SOW looks fine pending one small change: please add a clause that scheduled maintenance windows cannot exceed 4 hours in any rolling 30‑day period during the pilot. Our infra lead will confirm network availability on the Fri call.

We’re OK to proceed to DocuSign once that clause is added. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Lucas
VP Product, Stellus Health
